nativeBaseline.reference: native toggle buttons in a named group

library: Expose pressed state, define exclusive versus multiple and empty selection, and keep disabled controls inert.
consumer: Author button names and group purpose; choose supported selection policy.

notes: ToggleGroup is a named group of independently tabbable native toggle buttons, not a radio group or toolbar. Single selection permits empty state; multiple selection uses unique nonempty values.
All ports expose pressed state and native disabled behavior; Elements coordinates owned buttons with explicit stable data-vf-value or native button value and supports controlled value intent.
Audit mapping remains provisional; cross-browser, visual and manual AT evidence remain open.
